scoring_justification: The checker recomputes band gaps and metallicity from the raw total DOS file, then compares to paper-reported values with tolerances. This is a full T1 recompute, as the DOS file contains all necessary data.

hidden_assets.purpose: Table of paper-reported band gaps and metallic/insulating classification for each composition.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper text (Fig. 1 descriptions and body).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper's published results section; all values are the authors' own reported quantities.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual numerical results from the source paper that the task claims to reproduce. Without them, scoring has no ground truth.

outputs.description: Total density of states for each of the twelve α-Al2O3-based compositions. The checker recomputes band gaps and metallicity from this file.
Summary of band gaps (eV) or metallicity for each composition. Compared against the paper's reference band gaps with hidden tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the electronic character and band gaps from the raw DOS file to ensure consistency. The band_gap_summary is also checked for agreement with the recomputed values. Gold band gaps are paper-reported values and are hidden.

steps.description: Recompute band gaps and metallicity classification from the raw DOS file, then score against paper gold values.
